problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. The packages are as follows:

* Package Alpha: 30kg
* Package Bravo: 47kg
* Package Charlie: 44kg
* Package Delta: 41kg
* Package Echo: 46kg
* Package Foxtrot: 53kg
* Package Golf: 63kg
* Package Hotel: 70kg
* Package India: 37kg
* Package Juliet: 40kg
* Package Kilo: 61kg
* Package Lima: 42kg
* Package Mike: 66kg
* Package November: 69kg
* Package Oscar: 67kg
* Package Papa: 34kg
* Package Quebec: 56kg
* Package Romeo: 48kg
* Package Sierra: 32kg
* Package Tango: 46kg
* Package Uniform: 30kg
* Package Victor: 31kg
* Package Whiskey: 68kg
* Package X-ray: 40kg
* Package Yankee: 51kg
* Package Zulu: 41kg
* Package Asterisk: 55kg
* Package Dash: 44kg
* Package Plus: 67kg

Each truck has a maximum load capacity of 100 kg. Assign all packages using the minimum number of trucks. Every package must be placed on exactly one truck, and the total weight loaded onto a truck cannot exceed its capacity.
